arithmetic_intensity_note: 2 flop/weight (FMA=2) / bytes_per_weight. Batch=1 decode reads each weight once; there is no reuse to amortize the load.

gpu_occupancy.note: Memory-system occupancy is achieved_gb_s / honest_decode_ceiling. Launch occupancy is threads / 15360 from the decode-shape control.

dispatch_floor.note: Serial CB host tax dominates fused GPU dispatch tax. 1155 nops in one CB cost 1.48 ms GPU; 1155 serial CBs project to 222 ms host.

reconstruction_cost.isolation_note: excess_over_load_only mixes occupancy, issue, ALU and reconstruction. A same-launch load-only probe, or a same-shape cheaper codec, is required to isolate reconstruction. Q80 mixed vs Q4 (15.2 vs 2.57 GB/s) is the existing isolation, not this difference alone.

fs_honesty.caveat: fs_per_weight_served is an amortized throughput metric under concurrency, NOT physical femtosecond latency. A single weight's DRAM round trip is ~100 ns. Femtoseconds appear only because thousands of weights are in flight at once.

definitions.D: continue toward the measured honest decode roof

reachable_at_current_bytes.note: These budgets assume 100% of the honest decode ceiling (411.51 GB/s) and zero host tax. Host work can only make them stricter.

failures: No hardware resource named as saturated.
No evidence that the named resource is at saturation.
Named resource is at 0.8950 of its ceiling; saturation requires >= 0.90.
physical_limit.bar: A physical-limit claim REQUIRES naming the hardware resource actually at saturation with evidence. 'No further optimization is obvious' is not evidence.

claim_boundary.what_governs_decode: REUSE vs NO-REUSE, not gather vs sequential. Each weight is read once per token.
